_description: Canonical 32-field standardized schema registry across all LemGendary neural architectures.

nafnet.backbone: Simplified Channel Attention (SCA) & Intra-block Gate Block
nafnet.output: Restored Sharp RGB Tensor [B, 3, H, W], bounded [0, 1]
nafnet.dataset_structure: Compiled WebDataset sharded tar archives with paired blurry/sharp WebP tiles
nafnet.training_objective: L1 Pixel Reconstruction Loss + Structural Similarity Index (SSIM)
nafnet.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR (T_max=200, eta_min=1e-6) with dynamic Plateau Governor
nafnet.augmentation: Random horizontal/vertical flip, 90-degree rotations, synthetic motion blur kernels
nafnet.precision: Mixed Precision (AMP FP16) on Tensor Core GPUs, FP32 on Turing GTX 1650
nafnet.batching: Dynamic Sawtooth Minibatch Allocation (batch_size=8 at 256px, 4 at 384px, 2 at 512px)
nafnet.deployment: WebGPU / ONNX Runtime Web with 256px tiling and overlap blending
nafnet.hardware: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (4GB) / Apple Silicon MPS / WebGPU
known_failure_modes: Extreme saturated motion streaks exceeding receptive field
Severe ISO sensor noise combined with blur
known_limitations: Requires 256px overlapping tile windowing on 4GB VRAM hardware
nafnet.recommended_use: Camera handshake deblurring, out-of-focus optics recovery, video frame sharpening
nafnet.not_recommended_for: Facial landmark hallucination, text vectorization, forensic identity reconstruction

mprnet.task: Multi-stage progressive image deblurring and deraining
mprnet.backbone: 3-Stage Encoder-Decoder with Cross-Stage Feature Fusion (CSFF) and Supervised Attention Modules (SAM)
mprnet.dataset_structure: Compiled WebDataset sharded tar archives (MDS compatible)
mprnet.training_objective: Charbonnier Loss + Edge Loss via Laplacian Filtering
mprnet.augmentation: Random geometric transformations, synthetic streak overlay
mprnet.precision: FP16 Mixed Precision with gradient scaling
mprnet.deployment: Native C++ TensorRT engine / WebGPU compute pipelines
mprnet.hardware: Desktop CUDA GPU (GTX 1650 or higher), DirectML, MPS
known_failure_modes: High memory consumption in Stage 3 attention heads under large patch sizes
known_limitations: Higher parameter count (15.7M) requires progressive tile processing on 4GB GPUs
mprnet.recommended_use: Complex degraded footage restoration, film grain cleanup, rain streak removal
mprnet.not_recommended_for: Low-power mobile real-time video streaming (>60 FPS)

mirnet.task: Low-light image enhancement and multi-scale feature enrichment
mirnet.backbone: Multi-Scale Residual Blocks (MRB) with Selective Kernel Feature Fusion (SKFF)
mirnet.input: Low-light degraded RGB Tensor [B, 3, H, W]
mirnet.output: Luminance-restored and color-corrected RGB Tensor [B, 3, H, W]
mirnet.dataset_structure: Sharded tar WebDataset paired with LOL/ExDark ground truth
mirnet.training_objective: L1 Reconstruction Loss + Perceptual VGG-19 Feature Loss
mirnet.augmentation: Gamma perturbation, exposure scaling, chromatic jitter
mirnet.deployment: WebGPU / ONNX Runtime Web chunked inference
mirnet.hardware: NVIDIA GTX 1650, Apple Silicon MPS, Intel Arc
known_failure_modes: Color noise amplification in extreme zero-light dark regions
known_limitations: 31.7M parameter weight necessitates chunked execution for 4K imagery
mirnet.recommended_use: Night photography restoration, indoor underexposed footage brightening
mirnet.not_recommended_for: Extreme motion deblurring or object detection

ffanet.task: Single-image atmospheric dehazing and transmission recovery
ffanet.backbone: Group Architecture with Pixel Attention (PA) and Channel Attention (CA)
ffanet.output: Dehazed Clear RGB Tensor [B, 3, H, W]
ffanet.dataset_structure: WebDataset sharded tar with synthetic depth-guided haze pairs
ffanet.augmentation: Random cropping, rotation, synthetic scattering coefficients
ffanet.hardware: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / Apple Silicon / Intel Arc
known_failure_modes: Over-saturation of sky regions with high atmospheric light constants
known_limitations: Requires separate handling for non-homogeneous dense smoke
ffanet.recommended_use: Aerial drone imagery dehazing, landscape fog removal, automotive visibility clearing

yolov8n.task: Real-time bounding box object detection and class categorization
yolov8n.backbone: Modified CSPDarknet53 with C2f modules and SPPF pooling
yolov8n.dataset_structure: Ultralytics standard directory manifold with images/ and labels/ subdirectories
yolov8n.training_objective: Task-Aligned Focal Loss (BCE) + Distribution Focal Loss (DFL) + CIoU Loss
yolov8n.scheduler: Ultralytics Linear / Cosine decay with intra-fraction progression
yolov8n.augmentation: Mosaic (p=1.0), Mixup (p=0.15), HSV jitter, random perspective, Albumentations
yolov8n.precision: FP32 on Turing GTX 1650 (amp=False for numerical stability), AMP FP16 on Tensor Cores
yolov8n.batching: Dynamic Sawtooth Allocation (batch_size=16 at 320px, 12 at 480px, 8 at 640px)
yolov8n.deployment: Ultralytics Engine / ONNX Runtime Web / TensorRT runtime
yolov8n.hardware: Desktop CUDA GPU (GTX 1650), Edge Jetson, Mobile NPU
known_failure_modes: Dense object clustering occluding overlapping bounding boxes
Extreme aspect ratio distortions
known_limitations: 3.2M parameters prioritize latency (<5ms) over ultra-fine semantic segmentation
yolov8n.recommended_use: Real-time edge surveillance, automated sorting, UI element detection
yolov8n.not_recommended_for: Sub-pixel image deblurring or dense pixel-wise segmentation

ultrazoom.architecture: Residual Channel Attention Network (RCAN) with Sub-Pixel Convolution
ultrazoom.backbone: Residual in Residual (RIR) structure with Residual Channel Attention Blocks (RCAB)
ultrazoom.output: High-Resolution RGB Tensor [B, 3, s*H, s*W] where s in {2, 3, 4}
ultrazoom.dataset_structure: Sharded tar WebDataset paired HR/LR tiles
ultrazoom.training_objective: L1 Pixel Loss + Sobel Gradient Magnitude Loss
ultrazoom.batching: Sawtooth allocation: batch_size=8 at 64px LR patches
ultrazoom.deployment: WebGPU / ONNX Runtime Web sub-pixel convolution shaders
ultrazoom.hardware: NVIDIA GTX 1650, Apple Silicon MPS, WebGPU
known_failure_modes: Over-smoothing text characters at high scale factors (4x) without prior text conditioning
known_limitations: High scale factors require tiled overlapping inference to avoid tile boundary seams
ultrazoom.recommended_use: Print resolution upscaling, archival photo enlargement, e-commerce product asset zooming
ultrazoom.not_recommended_for: Motion vector de-interlacing or frame rate interpolation

hybrid_upn_v2.display_name: LemGendary Hybrid UPN v2 Universal Restorer
hybrid_upn_v2.task: Universal degradation restoration (blur, noise, compression artifacts)
hybrid_upn_v2.backbone: Multi-head Dual-Domain Residual Transformer with Wavelet Gating
hybrid_upn_v2.output: Restored Clean RGB Tensor [B, 3, H, W]
hybrid_upn_v2.dataset_structure: Compiled WebDataset sharded tar archives with composite degradation matrices
hybrid_upn_v2.training_objective: Charbonnier Loss + Frequency Domain FFT Loss + LPIPS Loss
hybrid_upn_v2.augmentation: Composite degradation injection (Bicubic downsample + Gaussian noise + JPEG compression)
known_failure_modes: Hallucinating fine textures when degradation noise floor exceeds 40dB
known_limitations: Higher compute footprint than pure NAFNet due to multi-domain frequency heads
hybrid_upn_v2.recommended_use: One-click mixed degradation restoration, social media low-quality upload cleanup
hybrid_upn_v2.not_recommended_for: Real-time edge video streaming (>30 FPS on integrated graphics)

hybrid_film_restorer.task: Archival analog film restoration (scratches, dust, grain, dye fading)
hybrid_film_restorer.architecture: Film Grain & Temporal Scratch Inpainting Network
hybrid_film_restorer.backbone: Dual-Branch Spatio-Temporal Attention with Latent Mask Inpainting
hybrid_film_restorer.input: Scratched / Faded RGB Tensor [B, 3, H, W]
hybrid_film_restorer.output: Pristine Inpainted RGB Tensor [B, 3, H, W]
hybrid_film_restorer.dataset_structure: Sharded tar WebDataset containing archival celluloid scans and synthetic scratch masks
hybrid_film_restorer.training_objective: Partial Convolution Masked Loss + Perceptual Style Loss
hybrid_film_restorer.augmentation: Synthetic vertical celluloid scratch generation, chemical blotch synthesis
hybrid_film_restorer.deployment: Desktop CUDA GPU / WebGPU shader pipelines
hybrid_film_restorer.hardware: NVIDIA GTX 1650, Apple Silicon MPS, Intel Arc
known_failure_modes: Mistaking sharp intentional background vertical lines (e.g. railings) for scratches
known_limitations: Color restoration assumes historical Kodachrome/Ektachrome dye profiles
hybrid_film_restorer.recommended_use: Archival 8mm/16mm/35mm celluloid film restoration, antique photo scratch repair
hybrid_film_restorer.not_recommended_for: Real-time webcam conferencing or autonomous driving

hybrid_multitask.task: Simultaneous deblurring, denoising, super-resolution and color balance
hybrid_multitask.backbone: Shared Multi-Scale Feature Extractor with Task-Specific Residual Decoders
hybrid_multitask.input: Degraded RGB Tensor [B, 3, H, W] + Task Selector Embedding
hybrid_multitask.output: Restored Multi-Task Output Tensor [B, 3, H, W]
hybrid_multitask.dataset_structure: Compiled MDS / WebDataset archives with multi-task annotation manifests
hybrid_multitask.training_objective: Dynamic Weighted Multi-Task Loss with Gradient Normalization (GradNorm)
hybrid_multitask.hardware: Desktop CUDA GPU (GTX 1650 or higher), DirectML, MPS
known_failure_modes: Negative transfer between extreme super-resolution and extreme deblurring tasks
known_limitations: Higher parameter count requires dynamic task branch pruning during export
hybrid_multitask.recommended_use: Master automated processing pipelines where degradation type is unknown

face_codeformer.task: Blind face restoration via discrete codebook prior
face_codeformer.backbone: VQGAN Pretrained Codebook with Multi-Head Self-Attention Transformer
face_codeformer.dataset_structure: Compiled WebDataset sharded tar archives with FFHQ/CelebA-HQ 512px aligned faces
face_codeformer.training_objective: Codebook Cross-Entropy Loss + L1 Loss + LPIPS Loss + Identity Cosine Loss
face_codeformer.augmentation: Synthetic facial degradation (blur, downsample, noise, JPEG)
face_codeformer.deployment: Desktop CUDA GPU / WebGPU shader execution
known_failure_modes: Identity shift when fidelity parameter w is set too low (over-prioritizing codebook)
Artifacts on non-frontal faces
known_limitations: Requires 512px facial alignment pre-processing (typically provided by RetinaFace)
face_codeformer.recommended_use: Old portrait photo restoration, out-of-focus facial restoration, identity-preserving sharpening
face_codeformer.not_recommended_for: General non-facial image restoration (e.g. landscapes, vehicles)

face_parsenet.task: Pixel-wise 19-class facial semantic parsing and landmark segmentation
face_parsenet.architecture: Bilateral Segmentation Network (BiSeNet) for Facial Parsing
face_parsenet.backbone: Dual-Path Spatial Path & Context Path with Feature Fusion Module (FFM)
face_parsenet.dataset_structure: Sharded tar WebDataset paired with CelebAMask-HQ 19-class masks
face_parsenet.augmentation: Random horizontal flip, scaling, rotation (-10 to 10 degrees)
face_parsenet.normalization: Standard ImageNet mean and standard deviation
face_parsenet.deployment: Desktop CUDA GPU / WebGPU / ONNX Runtime Web
face_parsenet.hardware: NVIDIA GTX 1650, Apple Silicon MPS, Intel Arc
known_failure_modes: Boundary ambiguity between hair and dark clothing under low contrast
known_limitations: Sensitive to non-standard face orientations (>45 degree yaw)
face_parsenet.recommended_use: Selective facial retouching, beauty makeup simulation, eye/mouth mask generation
face_parsenet.not_recommended_for: Full-body semantic segmentation or automotive scene parsing

retinaface.task: Single-stage face detection and 5-point facial landmark localization
retinaface.output: Face Bounding Boxes [B, N, 4], Confidence Scores [B, N, 2], 5-Point Landmarks [B, N, 10]
retinaface.dataset_structure: WebDataset sharded tar with WIDER FACE bounding box & landmark annotations
retinaface.training_objective: Multi-Task Loss (Classification BCE + Box Regression SmoothL1 + Landmark SmoothL1)
retinaface.precision: Mixed Precision FP16 on Tensor Cores, FP32 on CPU
retinaface.deployment: WebGPU / ONNX Runtime Web / Edge Jetson
retinaface.hardware: Low-power mobile NPU, NVIDIA GTX 1650, CPU
known_failure_modes: Heavily occluded faces (>80% occlusion) in crowded spectator scenes
known_limitations: Lightweight MobileNetV3-Small edge backbone trades hard-set mAP for ultra-low latency (<3ms)
retinaface.recommended_use: Real-time face tracking, pre-alignment for CodeFormer, identity bounding boxes
retinaface.not_recommended_for: Fine facial feature segmentation or skin lesion analysis

nima_aesthetic_mobile.task: Aesthetic image scoring and perceptual distribution prediction
nima_aesthetic_mobile.dataset_structure: Compiled WebDataset sharded tar archives with AVA 10-bin distribution labels
nima_aesthetic_mobile.training_objective: Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) Loss + Soft Spearman Rank Correlation
nima_aesthetic_mobile.augmentation: Random crop, slight color jitter, subtle aspect ratio scaling
nima_aesthetic_mobile.deployment: WebGPU / ONNX Runtime Web / Mobile Browser
nima_aesthetic_mobile.hardware: Mobile NPU, Intel Arc, NVIDIA GTX 1650, CPU
known_failure_modes: Bimodal score distribution on controversial artistic abstract photography
known_limitations: Evaluates global composition at 224px; insensitive to microscopic high-frequency artifacts
nima_aesthetic_mobile.recommended_use: Automated photo culling, album thumbnail selection, creative quality gating
nima_aesthetic_mobile.not_recommended_for: Technical noise floor measurement or camera sensor calibration

nima_aesthetic_efficientnet.task: High-accuracy aesthetic scoring with compound scaling
nima_aesthetic_efficientnet.backbone: EfficientNet-B0 with Compound Scaling and Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE)
nima_aesthetic_efficientnet.dataset_structure: Compiled WebDataset sharded tar archives with AVA ground truth
nima_aesthetic_efficientnet.augmentation: Random horizontal flip, slight rotation, color jitter
nima_aesthetic_efficientnet.deployment: Desktop CUDA GPU / WebGPU / Server REST API
known_failure_modes: Minor degradation under extreme aspect ratios (>3:1 panoramic crops)
known_limitations: Slightly higher compute than MobileNetV3-Small (5.3M vs 2.5M parameters)
nima_aesthetic_efficientnet.recommended_use: Server-side photo ranking, high-fidelity gallery curation

nima_aesthetic_pro.task: SOTA perceptual and artistic aesthetic scoring using Vision Transformers
nima_aesthetic_pro.backbone: Vision Transformer ViT-Base/16 with Multi-Head Self-Attention
nima_aesthetic_pro.dataset_structure: Compiled WebDataset sharded tar archives (high-resolution 384px tiles)
nima_aesthetic_pro.training_objective: Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) Loss + Contrastive Ranking Loss
nima_aesthetic_pro.precision: Mixed Precision FP16 on Tensor Cores
nima_aesthetic_pro.deployment: Desktop CUDA GPU / Server Cloud Inference
nima_aesthetic_pro.hardware: Desktop CUDA GPU (GTX 1650 or higher), Server A100/T4
known_failure_modes: High memory consumption during full attention calculation on 4GB VRAM
known_limitations: 86M parameters; not suitable for real-time edge processing without INT8 quantization
nima_aesthetic_pro.recommended_use: Definitive artistic ranking, professional photography competitions, archival quality auditing
nima_aesthetic_pro.not_recommended_for: Real-time edge video streaming on mobile devices

nima_technical.task: Technical image quality assessment (noise, blur, compression, clipping)
nima_technical.dataset_structure: Sharded tar WebDataset containing TID2013, LIVE, and CSIQ distortion pairs
nima_technical.training_objective: Earth Mover's Distance Loss + Distortion Classification Loss
nima_technical.augmentation: Synthetic distortion injection (JPEG, noise, motion blur, over-exposure)
nima_technical.hardware: Desktop CUDA GPU, Mobile NPU, CPU
known_failure_modes: Misinterpreting artistic shallow depth of field (bokeh) as technical defocus blur
known_limitations: Evaluates patches at 256px; requires tiled sampling for gigapixel scans
nima_technical.recommended_use: Automated dataset quality filtering, restoration before/after verification

nima_authenticity.task: Synthetic AI image detection and camera PRNU verification
nima_authenticity.dataset_structure: Sharded tar WebDataset paired Midjourney/DALL-E/SD against DSLR camera raw scans
nima_authenticity.training_objective: Binary Cross-Entropy Loss + Frequency Domain Consistency Loss
nima_authenticity.augmentation: JPEG recompression, Gaussian blurring, random cropping, color jitter
nima_authenticity.deployment: Desktop CUDA GPU / WebGPU / Server Cloud
nima_authenticity.hardware: Desktop CUDA GPU, DirectML, Apple Silicon
known_failure_modes: False positives on heavily post-processed analog scans with digital denoisers applied
known_limitations: Needs periodic retraining as newer generative diffusion models alter high-frequency noise fingerprints
nima_authenticity.recommended_use: Dataset provenance auditing, media authenticity verification, fake submission detection

classification_nsfw.task: Multi-category content moderation and explicit content gating
classification_nsfw.output: 5-Class Probability Distribution [B, 5] (Drawings, Hentai, Neutral, Porn, Sexy)
classification_nsfw.dataset_structure: Compiled MDS / WebDataset archives with 5-class balanced shards
classification_nsfw.augmentation: Random horizontal flip, slight crop, aspect ratio jitter
classification_nsfw.deployment: Client-side WebGPU / Desktop CUDA / Edge NPU
classification_nsfw.hardware: Desktop CUDA GPU, Mobile NPU, CPU
known_failure_modes: Ambiguity on classical fine art sculptures and museum nudity
known_limitations: Evaluates at 224px; extreme downscaled explicit stamps in large canvases may evade single-tile check
classification_nsfw.recommended_use: Automated dataset sanitization, user upload moderation gating, safe-search tagging

forex_predictor.task: Multi-pair, multi-timeframe Forex & Gold market direction and volatility forecasting
forex_predictor.backbone: Dilated Causal 1D Convolution Stacks fused via Multi-Head Cross-Timeframe Attention
forex_predictor.input: Multi-timeframe OHLCV Tensor [B, 6, T, 5] (M1, M5, M15, H1, H4, D1) + Technical Indicators
forex_predictor.output: Direction Probability [B, 3] (Buy, Sell, Hold) + Magnitude Regression [B, 2] (Take-Profit, Stop-Loss pips)
forex_predictor.dataset_structure: Compiled Parquet and Feather shards with walk-forward 6-fold cross-validation splits
forex_predictor.training_objective: Directional Cross-Entropy + Asymmetric Risk-Adjusted MSE Loss
forex_predictor.augmentation: Random time-masking, volatility jitter, price drift scaling
forex_predictor.normalization: Rolling Z-score normalization per asset timeframe window
forex_predictor.precision: FP32 full precision for financial decimal stability
forex_predictor.deployment: MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor (EA) C++ Bridge / Stateless ONNX runtime (<5ms inference)
forex_predictor.hardware: Desktop CPU / CUDA GPU / VPS Cloud Runtime
known_failure_modes: High-impact macroeconomic news black-swan spikes (e.g. NFP, interest rate decisions)
known_limitations: Strict zero-lookahead bias invariant requires stateless autoregressive inference
forex_predictor.recommended_use: Automated trade execution assistance, confluence confirmation, volatility bracket sizing
forex_predictor.not_recommended_for: Computer vision, image reconstruction, or static regression
